title: EvalsFile
description: Input schema for the runevals CLI. Generated suites MUST use the EvalDocument format (schemaVersion + items). The legacy flat-array format is also accepted by the CLI but must not be generated by this skill. A top-level object with a `prompts` key is NOT supported — the CLI parses it as a parallel string array and runs zero items.

EvalDocument.description: Eval document format with file-level default evaluators and per-item evaluator configuration. Always generate schema version 1.6.0 or newer.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. Generated suites must use 1.6.0 or a newer compatible 1.x version.

metadata.description: Optional document metadata supported by schema 1.6.0 and newer.

default_evaluators.description: Evaluators that apply to all items unless overridden by a per-item evaluators_mode: "replace". Recommended defaults: Relevance, Coherence, Groundedness.

items.description: Array of prompt objects. Must be named `items` (NOT `prompts`).

PromptsArray.description: Legacy flat-array format. Accepted by the CLI but must NOT be generated by the agent-eval skill. Use EvalDocument instead.

PromptObject.description: A single eval prompt with optional per-prompt evaluator configuration.

prompt.description: The user query to test. Write as a real end user would phrase it.

expected_response.description: Behavioral specification of the expected agent output. Describes content and behavior, not exact wording (unless ExactMatch is used).

context.description: Source text for Groundedness evaluation. Required for Perceive prompts. Must be the actual content from the knowledge source the agent is expected to retrieve — not a summary or paraphrase.

evaluators.description: Per-prompt evaluator configuration. In 'extend' mode (default), merged with default_evaluators. In 'replace' mode, replaces default_evaluators entirely for this prompt.

evaluators_mode.description: How to combine this prompt's evaluators with the file-level default_evaluators. 'extend' (default): merge, with per-prompt values taking precedence. 'replace': use only this prompt's evaluators (no LLM evaluators for Boundary/Deterministic prompts).

extensions.description: Optional extension point for custom item-level fields.
Optional extension point for custom thread-level fields.

EvaluatorMap.description: A map of evaluator name → evaluator options. Evaluator names are case-sensitive PascalCase.

Relevance.description: LLM evaluator. Measures response relevance to the query. Uses the configured judge backend (--judge-backend github-copilot or azure).

Coherence.description: LLM evaluator. Measures human-like quality and logical flow. Uses the configured judge backend (--judge-backend github-copilot or azure).

Groundedness.description: LLM evaluator. Measures factuality against context (if provided) or expected_response. Uses the configured judge backend (--judge-backend github-copilot or azure). Use threshold:4 for Perceive prompts.

Similarity.description: LLM evaluator. Measures how closely the actual response matches expected_response wording/intent. Uses the configured judge backend (--judge-backend github-copilot or azure).

Citations.description: Count-based evaluator. Checks for presence/count of citations. Deterministic — no judge model, works with any --judge-backend.

RetrievalQuery.description: Non-LLM evaluator. Verifies the agent's retrieval query matches expectations. Deterministic — no judge model, works with any --judge-backend.

RetrievalResult.description: Non-LLM evaluator. Verifies expected items appear among retrieved documents/messages/items. Deterministic — no judge model, works with any --judge-backend.

ExactMatch.description: String evaluator. Case-sensitive exact string match against expected_response. Deterministic — no judge model. Use with evaluators_mode replace.

PartialMatch.description: String evaluator. Substring match with similarity scoring against expected_response. Deterministic — no judge model. Use with evaluators_mode replace.

EvaluatorOptions.description: Configuration options for a single evaluator. All properties are optional.

threshold.description: Minimum score to consider a pass. For LLM evaluators (1–5 scale), default is 4.0. For string evaluators (0–1 scale), default is 1.0 (ExactMatch) or 0.7 (PartialMatch). Use threshold:4 to raise the Groundedness bar for Perceive prompts.

options.description: Evaluator-specific options for a custom evaluator.
